name: rex
description: A lightweight, cross-platform, screen-aware AI companion powered by local Ollama models.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --dir && ([ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ] && [ -d "release/mac-arm64/REX.app" ] && codesign --force --deep --sign - --identifier com.rex.app --requirements '=designated => identifier "com.rex.app"' --entitlements build/entitlements.mac.plist "release/mac-arm64/REX.app" || true)
